I replied to Pree in a thread in #central-team to confirm the correction: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23.

GBrain has no notes on either location. That fits, since my earlier attempt to save Dock 23 was blocked, so there's no wrong entry to fix. My Dock 23 reply from this morning is still in the channel. The new thread reply corrects it in the same channel, so anyone reading there will see Gate 47.
